title: ‘Saturday Night Live’ Is Coming to France
summary: A French adaptation of the American sketch comedy institution will premiere next month on the premium channel Canal+. It comes as a British version is hitting a stride.
caption: The cast of the French edition of “Saturday Night Live,” which premieres on Dec. 19 on the Canal+.

title: Trump’s Nvidia Push Shows Companies’ Importance in Global Economic War
summary: Presidents before him have bailed out companies in times of national crisis. Mr. Trump went further: He staked the fortunes of the United States on those of a favored chief executive.
caption: Jensen Huang in Las Vegas in January. He was reinstalled as chief executive of Nvidia, less than two weeks after resigning.

title: Stock Markets Slip as Nvidia and A.I. Stocks Erase Some of Monday’s Rally
summary: Shares have veered wildly for days, pushed and pulled by the drama at Nvidia and the rise and fall of Anthropic’s stock after its blockbuster public offering.
caption: Shares of Nvidia dropped a day after they surged on the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as the company’s chief executive.

title: Death Toll From Indonesia Factory Fire Rises to 26 With Dozens Unaccounted for
summary: As the death toll rose to 26, one rescue worker said that more victims might be found near a stairwell in the building. The police opened a criminal investigation.
caption: The remains of the factory, which is owned by the company Fonusa Agung Mulia, near Jakarta, on Tuesday.

title: For China, Jensen Huang’s Return to Nvidia Is a Mixed Blessing
summary: Beijing may welcome the return of the leading U.S. advocate for A.I. chip sales to China. But the saga could reinforce a Chinese push for self-reliance, analysts say.
caption: Nvidia posted a photograph of its reinstated CEO, Jensen Huang, on its official X account on Monday.
authors: David Pierson, Sui-Lee Wee and Cecilia Kang

title: China Investigates Chen Jining, Shanghai’s Party Leader, as Xi’s Purges Expand
summary: Before his abrupt downfall, the technocratic Chen Jining was seen as a future national leader in Xi Jinping’s China.
caption: Chen Jining, the Communist Party leader of Shanghai. He has a scientific education that was seen as fitting the priorities of China’s top leader, Xi Jinping.

title: Murder Charge Reinstated for French Police Officer in Teen’s Shooting
summary: The killing of Nahel Merzouk, 17, sparked nationwide unrest. The case against the officer accused of involvement has undergone repeated twists and turns.
caption: The death of Nahel Merzouk, 17, resulted in unrest across France. This protest was in Nanterre last year.

title: Prince William and Kate’s Country Home Is Broken Into; 2 Men Arrested
summary: The men were arrested near Anmer Hall, the couple’s country retreat in Norfolk, on Monday night.
caption: Anmer Hall on the Sandringham Estate in Norfolk, England, in 2013. The 10-bedroom house was given to William and Catherine as a wedding present by Queen Elizabeth II.

title: Iranian Singer Receives 74 Lashes for Performing With No Hijab
summary: Parastoo Ahmadi sang without wearing the mandatory veil in a virtual concert in 2024 that spread quickly online and drew the ire of the Islamic republic authorities.
tags: US and Israeli Attack on Iran (2026)

title: Houthi Attack on Skyscraper in Saudi Capital Wounds 11, Officials Say
summary: The people were wounded in the strike on a building in Riyadh, the Saudi authorities said. The Iran-backed militia and Saudi Arabia have been exchanging escalating attacks for weeks.
caption: The financial district in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, last month.

title: A Lion on the Loose Near Istanbul? Not So Fast.
summary: Blurry surveillance footage spurred a frantic search — until the Turkish authorities said it was unclear whether the animal was the feline.
caption: Members of the Turkish gendarmerie blocking a road, as police and animal welfare teams searched for a reported lion roaming an area north of Istanbul on Monday.

title: A U.N. Leader Focuses on the Deadly Problem of Road Safety
summary: Nneka Henry works for the United Nations to help develop solutions to the chaos and calamity caused by cars, motorcycles and scooters, and help drum up the resources to improve safety.
caption: Nneka Henry, head of the U.N. Road Safety Fund, in Geneva. “Road safety,” she said, “is a topic that is so unwieldy, so complex, that you really need a pooling of resources to effectively tackle it long term.”
